messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting canary rollout: chart=redwood-runtime v1.13.0-canary -> cluster=prod-us-east (3/3 canary pods)

maya: kicking this off during the 10:00-10:30 change window. pinning chart values for kv-cache & batch settings. will monitor latency and errors.

tom: heads-up — last time similar change caused 503 spikes on long-seq requests. can we start with 1 pod canary and 10% traffic?

maya: yes, starting at 1 pod. traffic-split set to 10%. values snippet I'm applying: 
```yaml
canary:
  replicas: 1
  trafficPercentage: 10
runtime:
  kvCache:
    enabled: true
    size: 16Mi
  batching:
    enabled: true
    maxBatchTokens: 2048
image:
  tag: v1.13.0-canary
```

ankur: ack. pin the model config too (context window and quant profile). last rollout regressed quality when model-context default changed.

maya: pinned modelConfig.context_window=4096 and quantProfile=fp16-optimized in values.

deploy-bot: Canary pods ready (pod/redwood-runtime-canary-0). health checks passing.

jess: I'll run the smoke prompts now (LLM quick-eval set). posting results in this thread.

jess: smoke results: 6/6 prompts OK, output length & structure look normal. latency median ~78ms for 256-token gen.

kai: monitoring latency and p50/p95 on the trace dashboard. setting guardrails: if p95 > 200ms or error-rate > 1%, we rollback. also alerting SRE channel.

maya: agreed. if we see CPU burst on the canary, scale to 2 replicas, but keep traffic at 10% until we clear perf checks.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic hit 10% target. traces show slight KV cache misses early, warming now.

ankur: note: we need to pin helm chart version in the release manifest to avoid accidental drift. using chart: redwood-runtime-1.13.0-canary.tgz in the pipeline.

maya: done — helm release created with version lock and values-file stored in S3: s3://redwood-releases/1719951234/values-canary.yaml

tom: timeline check — if canary stays healthy for 20m, we ramp to 30% then 60% then full over the change window.

jess: smoke checks after 10m: 6/6 OK, no semantic regressions. p95 = 110ms.

kai: p95 currently 120ms, error-rate 0.2%. continuing to monitor.

maya: proceeding with planned ramp to 30%. updating values: replicas=2, trafficPercentage=30.

deploy-bot: Applying new canary values... helm upgrade --install redwood-runtime ./redwood-runtime-1.13.0-canary.tgz -f values-canary.yaml --set canary.trafficPercentage=30 --namespace prod

deploy-bot: Ramp complete: canary pods=2, traffic=30%. health checks ok.

ankur: quick note on rollback command if needed: 
```bash
# rollback to previous chart version pinned in release history
helm rollback redwood-runtime 2 --namespace prod
# or explicitly set image tag and values
helm upgrade redwood-runtime redwood-runtime-1.12.0.tgz -f values-prev.yaml --namespace prod
```

maya: decision rules recap: rollback immediately if p95 > 200ms for >3m OR error-rate >1% sustained for >2m OR smoke-eval fails semantic checks. everyone ok?

tom: ok from infra side. have on-call standing by.

jess: QA: ok. will run expanded evals at 30% and post results.

kai: SRE: ok. auto-rollback policy set in platform to trigger on those thresholds. I'll leave manual override to maya/tom.

sre-bot: :lock: Change window registered 10:00-10:30 UTC. Post-rollout notes requested by ops.

maya: if we hit any unexpected behavior, call a rollback within the thread and I'll execute the helm rollback command. otherwise will promote full release after 30min stable.

jess: expanded eval at 30%: 48/50 prompts pass, 2 short hallucinations flagged but not regressions vs baseline. will log items to the release notes.

kai: p95=130ms, error-rate=0.4%. leaning green.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: ramping to 60% per schedule.

maya: good to promote to full at 60% -> 100% after another 10m if metrics stay steady.

ankur: remember to bump the chart version in CHANGELOG and tag the release once fully promoted. also confirm migration steps for cache-size change are reversible.

maya: noted. will file release notes and tag commit.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete: redwood-runtime v1.13.0 deployed to prod. logs saved to s3://redwood-releases/1719951234/logs

jess: final smoke after full: 50/50 pass. latency stable. closing the window. :tada:
